observation: Building the semantic map in the httpful consumer created roughly 16 MB of PHPStan cache below the legacy .agent-map/phpstan-cache root even though the current workflow state root is .agent-loop/map/.

evidence.summary: The real HTTPFUL-1 dogfood run created .agent-map/phpstan-cache while current agent-loop migration guidance and project layout place map state below .agent-loop/map/.

hypothesis: One agent-map PHPStan cache path still bypasses the current map-root authority and falls back to the retired .agent-map location.
validated_conclusion: The consumer run demonstrated map-state path drift: a derived cache was written outside the canonical .agent-loop/map tree, creating repository noise and contradicting the current state-root contract.
